body:
RegistryPage renders `<Navigate to="/" replace />` while `list` is still
undefined, which it always is on the first render — the web client has no local
mirror, so lists only exist after the first sync response. Reloading or deep-
linking /list/<id>/registry therefore lands the user on the overview instead of
the registry.

ListPage has the same guard but renders its "list not found" page instead of
navigating, so it survives the wait and resolves normally. RegistryPage should
do the same.

Found while writing the first tests for this screen ([[T-139]], [[T-145]]) — the
bounce is what made it untestable.
title: web: opening the registry screen directly bounces to the overview
